newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,815.6 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,815.6 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits fell by 433.5 million Swiss francs to 3,815.6 Million in the reporting period ended July 10.
Statement of July 11 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window fell by 60.0 million francs to 10.0 million in the reporting period.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 148.7 million francs to 2,046.3 million.
An SNB spokesman described the move as reflecting a normal drop in demand after the half-year.

"This does not indicate that we have returned to a tightening of policy. We continue to supply the market very generously with liquidity and try to keep interest rates low to prevent the Swiss franc from rising. That policy continues."
